mechanism: candidates_from_top15() filters Top-15 through semantic_document_ids(), which scores only document_id tokens against the question. For 'severity-one reporting windows', neither security-incident-policy nor remote-work-policy shares document_id tokens, so semantic_document_ids returns {}. candidates becomes empty, DeterministicVersionResolver never runs (version_resolution=null), analyze_case marks unresolved_version_conflict, and the router emits SOL/unresolved_version despite Top-15 containing both requested version identities with the severity-one reporting-window spans.
not_primary: TEMPORAL_MODE_ERROR — temporal_mode is correctly CROSS_VERSION with requested_versions [2025, 2026]
RETRIEVAL_MISS — both 2025 (60 minutes) and 2026 (15 minutes) spans are in Top-15 ranks 1-2
VALIDATOR_FALSE_CONFLICT — conflict flag is derived from null resolution, not competing same-scope values
QUESTION_PLAN_SPLIT — imperfect R1/R2 split is secondary; sibling cases with similar splits succeed once VERSION_SET_RESOLVED

A_cross_version_recognized.note: Planner category and temporal planner both treat this as multi-version; requirement texts are awkwardly split on 'and' but years are still present in the question.

E_resolver_received_both_versions.reason: semantic_document_ids returned empty set → candidates_from_top15 returned () → resolve() skipped

H_canonical_mappings_preserve_both.note: Mappings empty because unresolved_version_conflict short-circuited deterministic support

I_requirement_packet_both_years.answer: N/A_BEFORE_PACKET — failure precedes packet assembly; Sol later saw both year spans on R2 only under forced SOL path

J_deterministic_support_unique_version.answer: Indirect — unresolved_version_conflict=True because resolution was null, not because multi-version evidence was treated as conflict

K_local_validation_conflict.note: Did not reach multi-version validation of competing same-scope values
